turn: I finished the "Score slots by temperature zone" step by adding tests in tests/score_temp/test_zones.py that cover the zone and dock rules. The zone test checks that a frozen item is allowed in zone F02 and rejected in A01. The dock test checks that a position at (5.0, 40.0) counts as near the dock and one at (30.0, 0.0) does not. I wrote these as direct assertions on `allowed` and `near_dock`, so they don't depend on any other scoring code. I haven't described a test run here, so please run the suite yourself before relying on it. In the same commit I also fixed a small unrelated problem I noticed: the tests package was missing an import path setup, which could make test discovery fail depending on where pytest was started. Next I'll start "Seasonal velocity adjustment".

sidefix.title: Fix test package import path setup
sidefix.what: Added the missing import path setup for the tests package so pytest discovery no longer depends on the directory it is started from.
